claims.value: m03490-m03501 = technical replicate 1, fractions 1-12; m03503-m03514 = technical replicate 2, fractions 1-12; m03545 = technical replicate 3, fraction 10
claims.evidence: Raw-file sample IDs hv_0016_T1..hv_0027_T1 and hv_0028_T2..hv_0039_T2, acquired consecutively 2014-11-22 to 2014-11-26 on one instrument with one method; paper: one TMT10-plex fractionated into 12 fractions, ~5 ug per fraction dissolved and ~1 ug loaded per analysis. Fraction order inferred from sequential sample IDs/acquisition order; T1/T2 read as two injection series of the same 12 fractions (inference). m03545.raw: RAW sample ID hv_0037_T2 (same as m03512.raw, T2 fraction 10), same SPS-MS3 method, full size (421 MB), acquired 2014-11-29 from vial A8 -> re-injection of T2 fraction 10, coded as technical replicate 3, fraction 10 (fraction set by documented post-processing script). Whether m03545 replaced m03512 in the published search is unknown.

claims.evidence: Figure 1 legend: cells harvested at day 0 (hiPSC), day 5 (definitive endoderm), day 12 (foregut endoderm), day 17 (pancreatic progenitors).

Stage names from Figure 1 legend; CL:0002248 and CL:0000223 verified in OLS. CL has no exact definitive-endoderm/foregut-endoderm/pancreatic-progenitor cell term, so the broader endodermal cell is used for days 5-17 (inference).
PRIDE organism NEWT:9606; paper: human iPSCs; Cellosaurus OX 9606.

Paper: Coriell control fibroblasts AG16102 reprogrammed in-house into hiPSCs (two independent lines, Teo and Kulkarni labs); the line used for proteomics is not named, so a descriptive cell-line label is used.

claims.evidence: Methods: MS1 400-1400 m/z; MS2 CID in ion trap NCE 35; MS3 HCD NCE 55 in Orbitrap (SPS-MS3). Raw method name ..._ITMS2_..._CID35_..._FTMS3_10prec_HCD55_... confirms.
Basic pH RP HPLC, 96 fractions combined into 12.
Methods: reduced with 10 mM TCEP, alkylated with 15 mM iodoacetamide.
TopSpeed 2 s precursor selection for MS2/MS3 (data-dependent).

limitations: T1/T2 are interpreted as two injection series of the same 12 fractions (technical replicates); they were loaded from different autosampler vials, so a split into 24 distinct fractions cannot be fully excluded from the available evidence.
Fraction numbering within each series follows sequential raw sample IDs/acquisition order; no deposited fraction table exists.
Biological replicate numbering within a time point is arbitrary (channel order).
Which of the two in-house AG16102-derived hiPSC lines was used for proteomics is not stated in the paper.
Donor sex, age and ancestry come from the parental fibroblast's Cellosaurus record, not from the paper.
m03545.raw (hv_0037_T2, re-injection of T2 fraction 10) is annotated as technical replicate 3, fraction 10; whether it replaced m03512 in the published search is unknown.

m03515.raw (sample ID hv_0040_pg) is not annotated: it ran immediately after m03514 (2014-11-26 11:09) from vial C5 (same tray position as T1 fraction 1 / m03490), is about half size (194 MB), and its content ('pg') is not described in the paper or the deposit.

Two values are set by a deterministic post-processing script (scratchpad/PXD003338/postprocess.py) applied to the built file: fraction identifier 10 on the 10 m03545 rows, and the second comment[cleavage agent details] column (Lys-C). Diff against the build confirmed only those cells/that column changed.
